pb-website.title: Website checks
pb-website.intro: Check each client requirement, then approve the exact release.
pb-website.aiHelp: The saved source shown below leaves Chausar only after this approval.
pb-website.briefApproved: This exact brief has owner approval.
pb-website.files: Files to read, one per line
pb-website.sourceHelp: Copy the full commit identity and file paths from the client repository. No code runs or changes.
pb-website.previewHelp: A draft built from safe blocks. It is not a deployed site.
pb-website.formHelp: Hosted capture and desktop imports wait for named legal notice review. Add clients manually meanwhile.
pb-website.releaseHelp: Upload the assets in your Cloudflare Direct Upload account first. Each preview, production deployment and rollback asks separately.
pb-website.inspection: Check the hosting dashboard before another attempt.
pb-website.shipHelp: This decision covers saved requirement audits. UI and release health are separate checks.
pb-website.error.REQUEST_FAILED: The request could not finish. Review the current project and try again.
pb-website.error.DERIVED_STALE: The client brief changed. Prepare a new project.
pb-website.error.APPROVAL_CHANGED: The project changed. Review its current version before approving.
pb-website.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: A lawyer must confirm the notice rule first. Add clients manually meanwhile.
pb-website.error.SITE_CHECK_PLANNED: Install the website checker yourself, or use the repository CI report.
pb-website.error.SITE_HOST_SETUP_REQUIRE: Connect the exact hosting project for this session.
pb-website.error.SITE_AUDIT_REQUIRED: Read the source and resolve every requirement audit first.
pb-website.error.SITE_UI_CHECK_REQUIRED: A passing UI report for this exact version is required.
pb-website.error.SITE_HEALTH_FAILED: The preview did not return its expected marker. Nothing was released.
pb-website.error.SITE_HEALTH_REQUIRED: This exact preview must pass its health check first.
pb-website.error.SITE_CAPTURE_HOSTED_ONL: Use a form export CSV on desktop. Live capture needs the hosted app.
pb-website.error.PRIVATE_NEEDS_LOCAL: Private source stays manual until a qualified local model is available.
pb-website.error.SITE_AUDIT_INVALID: Choose a requirement and read its current source files before auditing.
pb-website.error.SITE_BRIEF_APPROVAL_REQ: Approve this exact requirements brief first.
pb-website.error.SITE_DEPLOYMENT_PENDING: The host is still building this deployment. Check its health again later.
pb-website.error.SITE_FORM_ALREADY_IMPOR: This exact form export was already imported.
pb-website.error.SITE_FORM_INVALID: Check the form fields, permission, notice and source address.
pb-website.error.SITE_HOST_FAILED: The host did not confirm the expected result. Inspect its dashboard.
pb-website.error.SITE_INPUT_INVALID: Check the website address, repository and requested fields.
pb-website.error.SITE_PREVIEW_INVALID: This preview contains unsupported or unsafe blocks. The prior preview is kept.
pb-website.error.SITE_PRODUCTION_CHANGED: The live deployment changed. Prepare a new release review.
pb-website.error.SITE_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND: This website project is no longer available.
pb-website.error.SITE_RELEASE_INSPECTION: The deployment identity is uncertain. Inspect the hosting dashboard before continuing.
pb-website.error.SITE_RELEASE_INVALID: This release cannot take that action. Read its current state first.
pb-website.error.SITE_REQUIREMENT_INVALI: Use distinct requirements with exact brief excerpts, keeping all owner locks.
pb-website.error.SITE_ROLLBACK_UNAVAILAB: There is no confirmed prior production release to restore.
pb-website.error.SITE_SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: Choose smaller plain-text source files, at most half a megabyte together.
pb-website.error.SITE_UI_REPORT_INVALID: The UI report is missing, too large or does not match this revision.
pb-website.error.NO_MODEL_CONNECTED: Connect your AI before reviewing a model request.
pb-website.error.GITHUB_READ_FAILED: Check the repository read token and exact commit.
pb-website.error.CLIENT_NOT_FOUND: Choose a current client for this website.
pb-website.error.BUSINESS_PAUSED: This business is paused. Resume it before approving outside work.
pb-website.formSetup: On the client site, post name, email, consent=true and source (the page address) to this destination. Show the approved notice and an unticked permission box. No tracking scripts.
pb-website.error.SITE_AUDIT_CURRENT: The observed files and requirement are unchanged. This audit is current.
